context: Daichi has stopped by his aunt Naoko's ramen shop in Osaka in the dead hour before lunch service.
purpose: aunt-nephew teasing — Kansai family roast with sincere affection underneath

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あんた、また髪伸びたんちゃう？
lines.en: Hey — your hair's gotten long again, hasn't it?
lines.style: Looks up from the counter. Loud, immediate, no greeting. The Kansai roast is the greeting.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おばちゃん、来た瞬間それかいな。
lines.en: Oba-chan, that's the first thing you say to me?
lines.style: Mock-offended. Sits down anyway. Voice already laughing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 本当のこと言うてるだけや。今、彼女おらんやろ、それで。
lines.en: Just telling the truth. You've got no girlfriend right now — that's why.
lines.style: Brassy comic logic. Wipes the counter without looking at him. The diagnosis is rapid.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: How do you even know that?
lines.style: Almost laughing. Genuinely surprised at the accuracy. JP and EN: both half-laugh.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 見たらわかるわ。…で、どう？元気にしてんの？
lines.en: I can just tell. …Anyway. How're you doing? Holding up?
lines.style: Pivot mid-line. The roast was the door — the real question is the room. Voice drops half a step.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まあな。仕事は忙しいけど、大丈夫。
lines.en: Mm — well. Work's busy but I'm okay.
lines.style: Quieter now. Honest under the teasing because she earned it.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ほな、ラーメン食べてき。時間あるやろ。
lines.en: Then have some ramen before you go. You've got the time, right?
lines.style: Already pulling a bowl down. The offer isn't a question.
